title: Fate/Prototype: Fragments of Sky Silver
description: Seven mages and seven Heroic Spirits contract, and fight to the death for the Holy Grail, a wish-granting vessel said to grant any desire. In 1999, the mage Sajyou Ayaka contracted with the Heroic Spirit Saber. Eight years before that war, in the Holy Grail War of 1991, it was Ayaka’s older sister, Manaka, who held Saber’s contract. Manaka said, “The magic of love is greater than any arcana a mage can wield.” Young Ayaka had no way of knowing the harsh fate that waited beyond those words.
author: Hikaru Sakurai / TYPE-MOON
